name: ClickScroll Content Loader
author: Galaxy Weblinks

sections.description:
The ClickScroll Content Loader Plugin allows users to dynamically load more posts or pages with a simple click or scroll action. This plugin provides an easy-to-use backend interface for configuring various options, ensuring flexibility for different post types and user preferences. Using this shortcode [clickscroll-content-loader]

Note: This plugin supports only one post type at a time. You cannot display posts from multiple post types in a single shortcode instance.

Pro Version Available

The Pro version allows you to create multiple shortcode configurations, each with its own settings.
This means you can create separate shortcodes for different post types, categories, or layouts — offering full flexibility.

Key Pro Features:

  • Create multiple shortcodes, each with different settings
  • Assign different post types per shortcode
  • Premium support

Get the Pro version: https://wp-plugins.galaxyweblinks.com/product/clickscroll-content-loader-pro/

Features

  • Select Post Type: Choose the post type you want to display.
  • Select Taxonomy: Automatically populates based on the selected post type.
  • Select Terms: Dynamically loads terms based on the selected taxonomy.
  • Show Post by Author: Filter posts by a specific author.
  • Show Content Type: Choose to display content as full content or excerpt.
  • Load More Posts By: Options to load more posts by click or scroll.
  • View Type: Choose between list view, grid view, or both.
  • Column: Set the number of columns (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the display.
  • Order: Choose between ascending or descending order.
  • Order By: Sort posts by ID, title, or date.
  • Exclude Posts: Exclude specific posts by entering IDs, separated by commas.
  • Filter by Post IDs: Include specific posts by entering IDs, separated by commas.
  • Posts Per Page: Specify how many posts to display before showing the “Load More” button.
  • Featured Image Width & Height: Set dimensions for featured images.
  • Hide Post/Page Title: Option to hide post titles.
  • Post/Page Title Length: Specify the maximum length for post titles.
  • Hide Content or Excerpt: Option to hide content or excerpts.
  • Content Length: Specify the maximum length for content or excerpts.
  • Show Search: Checkbox to enable a search box above the listing to search.
  • Hide Featured Image: Option to hide the featured image.
  • Hide Category: Option to hide the category label.
  • Hide Author: Option to hide the author name.
  • Hide Date: Option to hide the post date.
  • Applied Link On Whole Box: Checkbox to make the entire box clickable.
  • Read More Button Text: Customize the text for the “Read More” link.
  • Load More Button Text: Customize the text for the “Load More” button.
  • Post Not Found Text: Customize the text for the “Not Found” message.
  • Change Author Icon Image: Add url for a custom image for the author icon.
  • Change Date Icon Image: Add url for a custom image for the date icon.
  • Change Loader Image: Add url for a custom loader image for loading states.

Usage

Once activated, navigate to the plugin settings in the backend to select your desired configurations. The frontend will automatically adapt based on your selections. Use this shortcode to show listing [clickscroll-content-loader]. In php file use shortcode like this.

After inserting the shortcode on a page or post for the first time, please visit the plugin settings page and click Save Settings once to initialize the configuration properly.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for ClickScroll Content Loader.
  3. Install and activate the ClickScroll Content Loader plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire clickscroll-content-loader folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the ClickScroll Content Loader plugin.
sections.faq:
Where can I configure the plugin settings?

Go to the wordpress dashboard, check for the “ClickScroll Content Loader” in the left menu, and click on it.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all standard WordPress themes.

Can I use shortcode inside page builders?

Yes, it works with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, etc.

Why does the layout sometimes look different on my site?

The plugin is designed to work with all standard WordPress themes. However, some themes apply their own CSS styles that may affect the layout, spacing, or structure of the post listing. In such cases, minor CSS adjustments may be required to match your theme design.
